title: Exponential-Time Envelope
statement: For all natural numbers $C,c,K,r$, there exist natural numbers $A,e$ such that for every natural number $n$, $K\bigl(n+C\cdot 2^{(n+1)^c}+1\bigr)^r\le A\cdot 2^{n^e}$.
replaced: For all natural numbers $C, c, K, r$ there exist constants $A$ and $e$ with $K\,(n + C\cdot 2^{(n+1)^c} + 1)^r \le A \cdot 2^{n^e}$ for every natural number $n$.
